parents.course: Advanced Topics in Data Analytics & Data Science

ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisite: LIS/IS452- Foundations of Information Processing; or equivalent programming knowledge, w/consent of instructor. ### Building on the fundamentals introduced in LIS/IS452, this course adds skills, data structures, tools, & patterns needed for developing & modifying software to solve more complex problems & to improve code maintainability & reliability. These skills are relevant to many types of programming, but many scenarios used will involve data analysis, conversion, validation & processing pipelines. The course helps prepare students for work on larger projects with multiple developers. Includes test-driven design, more OOP design concepts, refactoring, profiling, introductory parallel processing & more. Primarily uses the Python language. Graduate student questions may be sent to ischool-advising@illinois.edu
